description:
All surfers share a common sensation that simply can’t be explained in words. After your very first wave, you’ll share it too. Our mission is to help you experience that sensation and to reach the next level of performance. Our goal is to enhance your total surfing experience through smart instruction in a personal environment.

Our surfing lessons in Waikiki are customized to fit any experience level and learning style. They are crafted individually for the beginner surfer who wants to test the waters for the very first time, for the intermediate surfer looking to improve on fundamentals or take on more challenging waves and maneuvers, and for the advanced professional level surfer who is on the search for a competitive edge or simply to push themselves to their own personal limits.

Our lessons for beginners will teach you the basic elements of the sport to get you riding waves —surfing etiquette, water safety, body positioning, board handling and positioning, paddling, and catching waves.

For our advanced students, the instruction takes on a refined direction that matches your riding style — correcting ‘bad habits’, identifying strengths and weaknesses in technique, competitive strategies, and surfing bigger waves.

Most importantly, all students will receive instruction that acknowledges the mental, emotional, and spiritual elements that make surfing such a unique and beautiful sport. You’ll learn how to connect with the ocean environment, understand the line up and the actions of surfers around you, and surf to express your personality.

Our lessons are customized to your skill level. All prices include a surfboard and all the equipment you need to get out and riding the waves. All you have to bring is your swimwear, towel, sunscreen and change of clothes.

itinerary:
-We’ll pick you up from one of our four convenient pickup locations in Waikiki and shuttle you to our shop located within the Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort and Spa. Or you will meet directly at our shop, 20 minutes prior to your lesson start time, to get checked in for your lesson. 

- Once at our shop you will get checked in, geared up and will watch our safety briefing. (10-15 minutes)

- From there you will be shuttled to our beach location and your lesson will begin. (up to 2 Hours)

- After the lesson you’ll be taken back to our shop to view some of your footage. At our shop you will have the opportunity to purchase your footage or some merchandise. (10-15 minutes)

-After your purchases are made, we will drop you back off at one of our four pickup locations in Waikiki. Or you can leave directly from our shop!
highlights:
Here at Ohana Surf Project we believe our clients are like family, and we strive to provide the best service to every person who chooses to join us on the water and we welcome their loved ones who come along to support them as well. We are passionate about surfing and specialize in three ways of teaching you how to glide across the water: surf, stand up paddle and bodyboard. All of our staff members have been in the business for many years and are some of the finest instructors in the industry. We love what we do and we enjoy working together, as a team and as ohana to make our students feel safe, comfortable, and successful.

Our biggest priority is SAFETY! All our coaches and guides are professional, trained in safety (CPR, lifeguard, first aid), and friendly. 

We look forward to welcoming you into our ohana and showing you the aloha spirit that has kept each of us here in Hawaii-- enjoying life & good company, respecting the 'aina (our mother earth), having fun and staying active.
check_in_details:
Customers will check in at our shop located within the Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort and Spa 20 minutes prior to their lesson start time. 

Students should come wearing swimwear, sunscreen and bringing a towel. We will have a safe place to store your belongings while you're out in the water. 

If you or anyone in your party has a tendency of getting motion/seasick, we'd recommend taking a remedy about an hour before your lesson. 

Please sign our online waiver before your lesson takes place. It will be one per adult, and any minors will be included on the waiver of a parent or guardian.

special_requirements:

-If any participants have any medical conditions or injuries that we should be aware of please advise the staff ahead of time.
-If any participants cannot swim, please advise the staff ahead of time as a private lesson may be required.

faqs:
-Can people with physical disabilities take surf lessons? 
- Absolutely! We have taught students of many abilities. We pride ourselves in making surfing accessible for all no matter their physical or mental disposition and can adapt lessons to meet specific needs.

- Our instructors are experienced in creating a supportive and patient environment. We recommend a private lesson for those with special needs to ensure one-on-one instruction and a customized approach. Please let us know of any special needs at the time of your booking.

-Do you offer a discount for multiple lessons? 
- We have multi-session package discounts available for 2 or more lessons. If you prepay for 2 or more lessons, the price per lesson is discounted.

-What if I am late for my lesson or my hotel pickup? 
- If you are going to be late for the lesson, please call us at 808-599-7873(SURF) as soon as possible. We can start your lesson late. If we are picking you up, and you will be late for the courtesy shuttle, please call us right away, we will likely be able to send another shuttle to get you or our shop is less than a 15 minute taxi ride away from any spot in Waikiki.

-Can I reschedule my lesson? 
- Yes. You may contact us by phone to inquire about rescheduling. If your desired time is available online, you may also reschedule via your confirmation email.

- Rescheduling between 48* and 4 hours before your lesson will be subject to a 20% rescheduling fee (must call by 6 pm the night before for any next day 9 am lesson times). Rescheduled lessons are no longer eligible for refunds once rescheduled.

- *For large parties of 9 or more, we will adjust to 72 to 4 hours.

-Do you provide transportation? 
- Our courtesy shuttle picks up from 4 locations in Waikiki (the Ilikai Hotel, the Romer Waikiki at the Ambassador, Don Ho Lane Van Depot, and Hyatt Regency Hotel). These locations are within a few blocks of most hotels in Waikiki. We keep our pick ups limited to these locations to keep things running as smoothly and timely as possible.

-Do you offer photography? 
- Yes! We take photos & videos during each lesson. Often the water photographer is one of our instructors and provides an added service of providing wave coaching and post-wave coaching and assistance, and they help to keep the lesson organized. We have photo packages available for purchase before & after the lesson. Footage purchased prior to the lesson start time includes a prepaid discount. We take footage of all of our students whether they prepay for the footage or not. We do not share your photos with other parties.

-Should I be worried about jellyfish or other sea creatures? 
- It is possible, but very rare to encounter jellyfish & even more rare to see sharks. Even on the cyclical days of the month that jellyfish are more likely be more present (the 8th, 9th & 10th days after a full moon), it is still very rare to find one in the area where we surf. Jellyfish stings may be uncomfortable, but are by no means something that requires medical attention unless you have an allergy. If you are at all concerned about jellyfish, we recommend wearing pants such as yoga or work out pants to help protect your skin. Our long sleeve surf shirts provide protection for the upper body.

- Occasionally, you may encounter bees drowning in the ocean. If you are allergic to bees, please inform us ahead of time.

- You may also see sea turtles, seals, and other small fish in the surf area. If you’re lucky, you’ll see dolphins further out or whales jumping on the horizon during the winter season.

-What types of boards do you have? 
- For surf boards, we have NSP hard tops ranging from 6’8 to 11ft, 12ft Southpoint & Blue Planet boards, plus we have Channel Island short boards, fun boards, and performance longboards.  For stand up paddle boards we have 10’0, 10’2 & 11ft NSP’s & 10’6 & 11’0 Blue Planet boards.  For body boards we have Triads in various sizes & BullyBoards.  Our 11’0 & 12’0 boards are reserved for our lessons.  Our 6’0 to 10’0 boards are available for rentals and lessons.  We have a 8’0 & 9’0 foam surfboards available for the novice surfer to rent. If you are looking for a specific board to rent, please give our office a call to confirm availability; 808-599-7873(SURF).

-Do you teach lessons in the rain? 
- Yes, we surf every day, rain or shine. Conditions here in Waikiki are almost always good to get in the water and ride some waves! Surfing in the rain is safe and fun! If, on the rare occasion there is a reason for us to cancel due to the conditions, we will inform you at the earliest convenience and either reschedule or cancel at a full refund.

-What are your lesson times and when are you open? 
- 2-hour lessons are available at 9 am, 12 pm & 3 pm daily, 365 days a year. We are open rain or shine. 1-hour lessons are available at our 3pm lesson. Phone lines are open from 8 am & 6 pm every day Hawaii Standard Time.

- We operate at the beach location from approximately 8:45am to 5:15pm daily around our scheduled lessons and during that time we can also help to provide rentals. Our shop, the Ohana Surf Center, within the Waikiki Beach Marriott Hotel, is open from 8:30am to 5:30pm.

- *There are times we may not be available at the beach at the beginning or end of our work day, if we do not have a morning or afternoon lesson scheduled or our last lesson ends early. For the most up to date daily hours of beach operation call our office to confirm. 808-599-SURF(7873)

-Where is your office/shop located? 
- Our shop, the Ohana Surf Center, is located within the Waikiki Beach Marriott at 2552 Kalakaua Avenue. This is where our customers meet for their lessons. We then shuttle them in our Surf School Bus™ vehicles to our surfing location at Queens Surf Beach, which is a short distance away.
